verdict.rationale: Auth0 is a SaaS identity platform that holds customer and user data, so asking whether that data is kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Private Cloud isolation and data-residency options are adjacent controls and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
